QuestInfo.name: Cannoneer Trailblazing
QuestInfo.0: So, what to do now? You could become a Pirate, like you originally planned on the boat. While you consider your options, go visit Cutter. He has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Cutter suggested becoming a #bCannoneer#k. He said you're a perfect candidate for his new pirate weapon. He added that you won't regret your decision once you start blowing monsters away with giant hand-held cannons. Is he right? Probably, but go see the Pirate Job Instructor, Kyrin, just to be sure.
QuestInfo.2: After Kyrin's pep talk, you have agreed to become a Cannoneer.

0.0: Well...you got yourself a monkey. That's pretty great. Hm...animal friend, good at swimming, escaped a deserted island...I think you have what it takes to be a pirate! How would you like to join the crew of the Nautilus? Better yet, how would you like to join as a #bCannoneer#k, and use my new weapon?
0.1: What, does Cannoneer sound strange to you? It describes people who use my Hand Cannon to blow things up! Very powerful! Lots of fun!
0.2: Hey, didn't you want to be an Explorer? Well, why not become a new kind of Explorer? Eh? Show Maple World just how strong you are with my help! I'm sure Kyrin would take you in.\r\n\r\n#b(If you exit through the door, you'll automatically move in front of Kyrin.)

yes.0: Here, go through here and meet Kyrin. She'll make your promotion to Cannoneer official.

no.0: You really don't want to be a Cannoneer? Unacceptable! For your own good, I'll make sure the other Job Instructors blacklist you. It's cannons or nothing, buddy!
